page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8369B processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2 threads per core. It provides 8.0 GB of dedicated system memory, translating to 4.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the ecs.g7nex.large delivers moderate single-core performance but exhibits limitations in multi-core and memory-intensive operations. In single-core tests, the instance achieved average ratings, with a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1880.59 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1519.0. However, multi-core and memory benchmarks fall into the lower percentiles. The stress-ng multi-core performance score of 1931.67 and Geekbench multi-core score of 1774.0 are rated as poor. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with read-only large block bandwidth at 14.51 GB/sec and write large block bandwidth at 13.41 GB/sec.

Given the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance is positioned as an entry-level general-purpose resource. The primary tradeoff is the low multi-core scaling and weak memory throughput, which makes it less suitable for heavy database operations, complex software compilation, or parallel processing tasks. For example, the Passmark database operations score of 997.36 and Redis SET throughput of 1.91 million operations per second are relatively low. The instance is best suited for lightweight, single-threaded applications, basic web serving, or development environments that do not require high memory bandwidth or intensive multi-core computation.
